find_aircraft_by_squawk.description: Find every aircraft squawking a transponder code right now, worldwide. Use 7700 to find aircraft declaring an emergency, 7600 for radio failure or 7500 for a hijack. Often none: that comes back as an empty list, not a failure. No API key required.
find_aircraft_by_squawk.name: find_aircraft_by_squawk

parameters.description: The four-digit transponder code, each digit from 0 to 7, such as 7700.
parameters.name: squawk

parameters.description: Keep every aircraft, only those in the air, or only those on the ground. Near an airport, 'Only airborne' leaves out parked aircraft and airport vehicles.
parameters.name: flight_status

parameters.description: The most aircraft to return, from 1 to 1000. The result also says how many match altogether.
parameters.name: limit

aircraft.description: The aircraft found, each with its position, altitude and speed.

items.description: One aircraft as adsb.lol sees it right now.

altitude_baro_ft.description: Its barometric (pressure) altitude in feet, the one air traffic control uses. Empty on the ground or when it reports none.

altitude_geom_ft.description: Its geometric (GPS) altitude in feet. Empty when it reports none.

bearing_deg.description: Which way it lies from the point searched, in degrees clockwise from true north. Only set by the area and closest searches.

callsign.description: The callsign it is broadcasting, such as 'BAW256' (airline code and flight number) or its registration for a private flight. Empty when it sends none.

category.description: The ADS-B emitter category it broadcasts, such as 'A3'. A means aircraft by size, B gliders, balloons and drones, C vehicles and obstacles on the ground.

category_description.description: That category in words, such as 'Large (75,000 to 300,000 lb)'.

distance_nm.description: How far it is from the point searched, in nautical miles. Only set by the area and closest searches.

emergency.description: The emergency it is declaring, as a code: general, lifeguard, minfuel, nordo, unlawful, downed or reserved. Empty when there is none.

emergency_description.description: That emergency in words, such as 'Minimum fuel'.

ground_speed_kt.description: Its speed over the ground in knots.

hex.description: The aircraft's ICAO 24-bit transponder address as 6 hex digits, such as '4ca87c'. It never changes for an airframe, so it is the way to look the same aircraft up again. A leading '~' marks an address that is not an ICAO one (a TIS-B or anonymous target).

ladd.description: True when it is on the FAA's LADD list: its owner asked for it not to be shown on public flight trackers.

latitude.description: Its latitude in degrees. Empty when it reports no position.

longitude.description: Its longitude in degrees. Empty when it reports no position.

map_url.description: Its page on adsb.lol's live map, for a link in a message.

military.description: True when adsb.lol's aircraft database marks it military.

on_ground.description: True when it reports being on the ground.

pia.description: True when it flies an FAA privacy ICAO address (PIA), a temporary address that hides who owns it.

position_seconds_ago.description: How many seconds old its position is.

registration.description: Its registration (tail number), such as 'G-XLEA', from adsb.lol's aircraft database. Empty when the database has none.

seen_seconds_ago.description: How many seconds ago a receiver last heard it.

source.description: Where its position came from: 'ADS-B' (broadcast by the aircraft), 'MLAT' (worked out by receivers from timing), 'TIS-B' or 'ADS-R' (relayed from ground radar or another link), and so on.

squawk.description: The four-digit transponder code air traffic control gave it, such as '2000'. 7500, 7600 and 7700 mean hijack, radio failure and emergency.

track_deg.description: The direction it is moving over the ground, in degrees clockwise from true north (0 to 360).

type_code.description: Its ICAO type designator, such as 'A388' for an Airbus A380 or 'B738' for a Boeing 737-800. Empty when the database has none.

vertical_rate_fpm.description: How fast it is climbing (positive) or descending (negative), in feet per minute.

as_of.description: When adsb.lol's live picture was taken, in UTC (ISO 8601).

flight_status.description: Which aircraft were kept: any, airborne or on_ground.

more_available.description: Whether raising the limit would return more aircraft.

total.description: How many aircraft match altogether. More than the count when the limit cut the list short.

category_description.description: That category in words, such as 'Large (75,000 to 300,000 lb)'.

distance_nm.description: How far it is from the point searched, in nautical miles. Only set by the area and closest searches.

emergency.description: The emergency it is declaring, as a code: general, lifeguard, minfuel, nordo, unlawful, downed or reserved. Empty when there is none.

emergency_description.description: That emergency in words, such as 'Minimum fuel'.

ground_speed_kt.description: Its speed over the ground in knots.

hex.description: The aircraft's ICAO 24-bit transponder address as 6 hex digits, such as '4ca87c'. It never changes for an airframe, so it is the way to look the same aircraft up again. A leading '~' marks an address that is not an ICAO one (a TIS-B or anonymous target).

ladd.description: True when it is on the FAA's LADD list: its owner asked for it not to be shown on public flight trackers.

latitude.description: Its latitude in degrees. Empty when it reports no position.

longitude.description: Its longitude in degrees. Empty when it reports no position.

map_url.description: Its page on adsb.lol's live map, for a link in a message.

military.description: True when adsb.lol's aircraft database marks it military.

on_ground.description: True when it reports being on the ground.

pia.description: True when it flies an FAA privacy ICAO address (PIA), a temporary address that hides who owns it.

position_seconds_ago.description: How many seconds old its position is.

registration.description: Its registration (tail number), such as 'G-XLEA', from adsb.lol's aircraft database. Empty when the database has none.

seen_seconds_ago.description: How many seconds ago a receiver last heard it.

source.description: Where its position came from: 'ADS-B' (broadcast by the aircraft), 'MLAT' (worked out by receivers from timing), 'TIS-B' or 'ADS-R' (relayed from ground radar or another link), and so on.

squawk.description: The four-digit transponder code air traffic control gave it, such as '2000'. 7500, 7600 and 7700 mean hijack, radio failure and emergency.

track_deg.description: The direction it is moving over the ground, in degrees clockwise from true north (0 to 360).

type_code.description: Its ICAO type designator, such as 'A388' for an Airbus A380 or 'B738' for a Boeing 737-800. Empty when the database has none.

vertical_rate_fpm.description: How fast it is climbing (positive) or descending (negative), in feet per minute.

as_of.description: When adsb.lol's live picture was taken, in UTC (ISO 8601).

flight_status.description: Which aircraft were kept: any, airborne or on_ground.

found.description: Whether any aircraft was within the radius.

latitude.description: The latitude of the centre searched.

longitude.description: The longitude of the centre searched.

radius_nm.description: The radius searched, in nautical miles.

get_flight_route.description: Get the route on file for a flight's callsign: where it flies from and to, any stops, and each airport's name, codes and place. Give the aircraft's position too to check the route still fits the flight. A callsign with no route on file comes back with 'found' set to false rather than failing the step. No API key required.

get_flight_route.name: get_flight_route

parameters.description: The flight's callsign as broadcast, such as BAW256 (the airline's ICAO code and flight number).
parameters.name: callsign

parameters.description: Where the aircraft is now, to check the route on file fits the flight: the latitude from an earlier aircraft lookup. Leave both empty to skip the check.
parameters.name: latitude

parameters.description: Where the aircraft is now: the longitude from the same lookup. Leave both empty to skip the check.
parameters.name: longitude

description: Track aircraft live with adsb.lol, an open flight tracker run by a community of ADS-B receivers. Find what is flying over a place, look up an aircraft by hex code, callsign or registration, find every aircraft of a type or squawking an emergency code, list military aircraft, and get a flight's route and airports. No account or API key required.
